attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.finding: The production serve declines an earned retirement with `record_retired` / `no_coverage` (the P-301 defect's premise).
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.produced_by: a live curl of the facets route for the gold node 48209:135570.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.re_tested_by: two independent mechanisms: (a) the same live probe repeated for a second retired node (48209:135540) and the bytes compared to the dispatch's quotation; (b) attribution of the SERVING REVISION to an LDT commit -- `gcloud run services describe` shows 100% of traffic on cortex-api-00815-fiw, `gcloud run revisions describe` dates it 2026-09-16T20:28:20Z, and `gh run list --workflow 'Cloud Run Deploy (cortex-api)'` shows the workflow_dispatch runs bracketing that timestamp (20:27:46Z and 20:31:53Z) both on head 9ce30b81cde576bb942af8616fcdeb4d80dba543; the file exported at that commit contains the gtmErrorBody("no_coverage", "record_retired") call site.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.result: HOLDS. Two retired nodes answer the same body byte-for-byte (912 bytes each, differing only in the id inside `basis`/`scopeSearched`), and the deployed source declares the token.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.residual: The image carries NO build provenance (`--format=yaml(buildDetails.provenance)` -> null), so the revision->commit mapping is inference from timestamps + deploy-run head SHAs, not a signature. It is corroborated by behaviour, and no conclusion in this lane depends on the exact commit: the walk grades on the BODY it receives plus the STORE row, and both were measured directly.

attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.finding: `not_baked` is not dead, so keeping it is evidence-based and not sentiment.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.produced_by: reading the LDT source at the serving commit.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.re_tested_by: probing the live surface for a body that could only come from that branch: a fabricated node id (48209:999999) that was never baked.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.result: HOLDS, twice over. Production: 404 {"error":"not_baked","errorClass":"no_coverage","message":"No baked facets for this parcel node"}. The staging tag (cortex-api-00765-gip, built 2026-09-10T16:14:10Z, i.e. BEFORE P-206) answers the same body. Two serving revisions emit it today; deleting the token would have made the walk blind to both.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.secondFindingFromTheSameProbe: The staging revision answers 200 with a baked card for the RETIRED nodes 48209:135540 and 48209:135570 -- it neither declines nor excludes them. So the staging tag is a third distinct behaviour, not a copy of production, and a walk pointed at it would fail those nodes for a reason P-301 does not address. Recorded as fleet memory, not fixed here.

attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.finding: Half (ii) -- the store read -- is still necessary, and the 16 rows this walk failed on will flip to RECORD_RETIRED once half (i) is fixed.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.produced_by: the unit tests (a store resolver handed to walkParcel) and the dispatch's statement that the store holds the gold's row at run eb1d2676.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.re_tested_by: reading the serving store directly, read-only, under a heavy-scan lease, for ALL 16 failing node keys at once; then reading the walk's own timestamp and each failing row's grade from the factory store.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.result: HOLDS, and stronger than the dispatch claims. 16/16 nodes hold recordRetirement {status: retired, verdict: absent-verified}, updated 2026-09-17T09:57:38Z-09:58:02Z. The walk ran at 2026-09-17T10:28:02Z -- about 30 minutes LATER. So at the walk's own timestamp half (ii) was already satisfiable for the whole cohort, and every one of the 16 rows recorded {"grade":"BP-MEANING-01","reason":"HTTP 404"} with no declinedAtServe field: the only thing that failed them was half (i).
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.whatThisDoesNotProve: It does not prove the re-walk turns green, because that requires running a walk, which this lane may not do. It removes the other explanations for those 16 rows; the re-walk is the integration seat's grade.

attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.finding: The drift control is real -- it can fail.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.re_tested_by: the checked-in test file (5 tests, incl. the comparator in BOTH directions and a pre-P-206 route fixture), the CI run's literal output, and the selftest's exit code.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.result: HOLDS. CI printed the real check's JSON: {"ok":true,"accepted":["not_baked","record_retired"],"declared":["not_baked","record_retired"],"source":"ldt-vintage-main/artifacts/api-server/src/routes/brokerageNodeFacets.ts","revision":"dca5ec2"}. The self-test fixtures include a pre-P-206 source (declares not_baked only) and assert it is a DIVERGENCE, so a guard that always passed would fail its own suite.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.knownLimit: It compares against LDT main, not the deployed revision (stated in the script header and in CP1). The walk's `declinedRetirement.byRefusalError` is the compensating channel.

attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.finding: The lane's change is what makes the tests pass -- i.e. the tests are not vacuous.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.re_tested_by: the negative control: origin/main's `src/jobs/verify-walk.mjs` written into the same tree (git show origin/main:... > file), the P-301 test run against it, then the file restored and the restore verified by comparing against a saved copy (0 differing lines) with `git status` clean.
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.result: HOLDS: 9 tests, 3 pass / 6 fail against origin/main's walk -- the failures read exactly the dispatch's defect (actual 'BP-MEANING-01' vs expected 'RETIRED'; actual 'not_baked' vs expected 'record_retired'). On the branch: 27/27 for the two walk test files, 5/5 for the drift control's test, and the drift control itself ok twice (self-test + real).
attackOnMyOwnLoadBearingFindings.whyTheOtherThreePassOnMain: They are the falsifier-direction tests (a non-refusal body keeps its historical grade; the store is not reached for a non-refusal; the body's own retirement object is not evidence). They pass on main BECAUSE main has no decline path at all -- which is the defect, and is why they are not evidence of correctness on their own.

whatIDidNotIndependentlyVerify: 48491 (Williamson): the dispatch says every declined retirement there grades BP-MEANING-01 too. I did not measure it. Measuring it means either running a walk (forbidden) or enumerating that county's retired nodes and probing the serve route for each; I probed the Hays route only. The code path is county-blind, so the claim is plausible, but it is UNMEASURED here and the integration seat's Williamson re-walk is its grade.

whereTheFailuresWere.theOneLocalFailure: test/ctx-b3-store-census.test.mjs:137 'resolveLeafPaths against the real pinned LDT checkout agrees with the maintained mirror' -- the local LDT checkout yields six leaf paths while the maintained mirror lists five (an extra baseFacts.situsAddress). It fails IDENTICALLY on origin/main (base run: same test, same count), so it is a local-harness artifact, not this lane's. It is also the reason the lane does not claim a green local suite on this host.
whereTheFailuresWere.theSecondLocalFailureIExpected: p3-absence.test.mjs:582 (the documented OPS-21 S3 non-vacuity finding) fails on this host in both the base and branch runs. It is out of scope for P-301 and predates it.
whereTheFailuresWere.theLesson: Report the delta, not a green. A lane that had reported 'suite green' from this host would have been wrong twice over.

mostImportantThingInThisReview: The four tests that DID flip (A-201 for both measured bodies, the both-sources grade, and the refusal-token record) are the only ones that distinguish the branch from main, and the store measurement is what makes them mean something: half (ii) was already true for all 16 nodes half an hour before the walk ran, so P-301's half (i) is not a hopeful hypothesis about what the store might contain -- it is the last missing piece for a cohort whose rows are already on the shelf. The weakest link is the inference that the deployed production revision corresponds to LDT 9ce30b81 (no image provenance exists); nothing in the change depends on it, because the walk grades on the body it actually receives and the store row it actually reads.
